description: Add mobile-first global CSS foundations, viewport meta tags, safe-area support, and responsive Sidebar + Navbar layouts with hamburger menu
steps: 1. Add viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=5 to src/app/layout.tsx inside <head> element. Add iOS-specific meta tags for status-bar-style and viewport-fit=cover

2. Add iOS safe-area CSS variables and mobile touch utilities to src/app/globals.css: env(safe-area-inset-*) variables, touch-action: manipulation for buttons, min-height: 44px / min-width: 44px utility class .touch-target, -webkit-tap-highlight-color transparent
3. Update tailwind.config.js to ensure default breakpoints are correct: sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px), xl (1280px), 2xl (1536px)

4. Transform Sidebar (src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx) to be hidden on mobile (<md breakpoint) by default. Add hamburger menu trigger button to Navbar. On mobile, Sidebar becomes a slide-in overlay drawer from left with backdrop. Existing collapse/expand toggle remains for desktop only. Use fixed positioning with z-50 for overlay, add backdrop with onClick to close, ensure Close/X button is 44x44px touch target

5. Update Navbar (src/components/layout/Navbar.tsx) to show hamburger menu icon (Menu from lucide-react) on mobile (<md), positioned in top-left. Hide user profile text on small screens (show avatar only). Stack notification and user menu dropdowns to avoid overflow. Navbar height remains 64px (h-16) but adjust padding: px-3 on mobile, px-6 on desktop. Ensure all icon buttons are min 44x44px

6. Update GlobalSearchModal (src/components/layout/GlobalSearchModal.tsx) to be full-screen on mobile: use 'inset-0' instead of 'pt-16 sm:pt-20', max-w-full on mobile, max-w-2xl on md+, rounded corners only on desktop
acceptance_criteria: Viewport meta tag present in layout.tsx with device-width and initial-scale=1
Safe-area CSS variables defined in globals.css with env(safe-area-inset-top) etc
Sidebar is hidden on screens <768px (mobile) and shows as overlay drawer when hamburger is clicked
Navbar displays hamburger menu on mobile (<md) and full layout on desktop
GlobalSearchModal is full-screen on mobile, centered modal on desktop
All interactive buttons and icons in Navbar and Sidebar meet 44x44px minimum touch target
verification: Run 'npm run build' and verify no TypeScript or build errors
Test in browser at 375px width: Sidebar should be hidden, hamburger visible in Navbar, clicking hamburger shows Sidebar overlay
Test GlobalSearchModal at 375px: should be full-screen. Test at 1024px: should be centered with max-w-2xl
